mapper.sql: flt01_company_std_id AS company_std_id, flt01_company_id AS company_id, TO_CHAR(flt01_start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS start_date, flt01_total_invest_amt AS total_invest_amt, flt01_invest_amt_calc_target_cd AS invest_amt_calc_target_code, f_cdnm('FloorTrInvestCalcTargetCode', flt01_invest_amt_calc_target_cd, flt01_company_id, flt01_start_date) AS invest_amt_calc_target_name, COALESCE(flt01_invest_amt_over_check_yn, 'false') AS invest_amt_over_check_yn, COALESCE(flt01_invest_limit_unvisible_yn, 'false') AS invest_limit_unvisible_yn, flt01_turnover_rate AS turnover_rate, flt01_appr_over_rate AS appr_over_rate, flt01_appr_qty_over_rate AS appr_qty_over_rate, flt01_appr_valid_days AS appr_valid_days, flt01_std_date_type AS std_date_type, f_cdnm('FloorTrStdDateType', flt01_std_date_type, flt01_company_id, flt01_start_date) AS std_date_type_name, COALESCE(flt01_fund_hold_stk_yn, 'false') AS fund_hold_stk_yn, CASE WHEN COALESCE(flt01_lock_up_cd,'1') = '1' THEN f_cdnm('FloorTrLockUpCheckCode', flt01_lock_up_cd, flt01_company_id, flt01_start_date) ||' ('||COALESCE(flt01_lock_up_days||f_cdnm('FloorTrLockUpCalcStdCode', flt01_lock_up_calc_std_cd, flt01_company_id, flt01_start_date) ,'기간 미입력')||')' ELSE '매수주문횟수 ' || (CASE WHEN COALESCE(flt01_buy_opr_day_yn,'false') = 'false' THEN '' ELSE '일간 3회'||(CASE WHEN COALESCE(flt01_buy_opr_month_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN ', ' ELSE '' END) END) || (CASE WHEN COALESCE(flt01_buy_opr_month_yn,'false') = 'false' THEN '' ELSE '월간 30회' END) ||' 초과 체크' END AS lock_up_detail_name, TO_CHAR(flt01_rpt_start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS rpt_start_date, COALESCE(flt01_tr_file_evid_yn, 'false') AS tr_file_evid_yn, COALESCE(flt01_no_account_skip_yn, 'false') AS no_account_skip_yn, flt01_lock_up_cd AS lock_up_code, flt01_lock_up_days AS lock_up_days, flt01_lock_up_calc_std_cd AS lock_up_calc_std_code, flt01_buy_opr_day_yn AS buy_opr_day_yn, flt01_buy_opr_month_yn AS buy_opr_month_yn
mapper.select: SELECT FROM flt01_company_std WHERE flt01_company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY flt01_start_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flt01_company_std (flt01_company_std_id, flt01_company_id, flt01_start_date, flt01_total_invest_amt, flt01_invest_amt_calc_target_cd, flt01_invest_amt_over_check_yn, flt01_invest_limit_unvisible_yn, flt01_turnover_rate, flt01_appr_over_rate, flt01_appr_qty_over_rate, flt01_appr_valid_days, flt01_std_date_type, flt01_fund_hold_stk_yn, flt01_rpt_start_date, flt01_tr_file_evid_yn, flt01_no_account_skip_yn, flt01_lock_up_cd, flt01_lock_up_days, flt01_lock_up_calc_std_cd, flt01_buy_opr_day_yn, flt01_buy_opr_month_yn) VALUES (#{companyStdId}, #{companyId}, CAST(#{req.startDate} AS date), #{req.totalInvestAmt,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{req.investAmtCalcTargetCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COALESCE(#{req.investAmtOverCheckYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'false'), COALESCE(#{req.investLimitUnvisibleYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'false'), #{req.turnoverRate,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{req.apprOverRate,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{req.apprQtyOverRate,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{req.apprValidDays,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{req.stdDateType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COALESCE(#{req.fundHoldStkYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'false'), CAST(#{req.rptStartDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS date), COALESCE(#{req.trFileEvidYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'false'), COALESCE(#{req.noAccountSkipYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'false'), #{req.lockUpCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{req.lockUpDays,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{req.lockUpCalcStdCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{req.buyOprDayYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{req.buyOprMonthYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.update: UPDATE flt01_company_std SET flt01_start_date = CAST(#{req.startDate} AS date), flt01_total_invest_amt = #{req.totalInvestAmt,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, flt01_invest_amt_calc_target_cd = #{req.investAmtCalcTargetCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, flt01_invest_amt_over_check_yn = COALESCE(#{req.investAmtOverCheckYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'false'), flt01_invest_limit_unvisible_yn = COALESCE(#{req.investLimitUnvisibleYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'false'), flt01_turnover_rate = #{req.turnoverRate,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, flt01_appr_over_rate = #{req.apprOverRate,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, flt01_appr_qty_over_rate = #{req.apprQtyOverRate,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, flt01_appr_valid_days = #{req.apprValidDays,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, flt01_std_date_type = #{req.stdDateType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, flt01_fund_hold_stk_yn = COALESCE(#{req.fundHoldStkYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'false'), flt01_rpt_start_date = CAST(#{req.rptStartDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS date), flt01_tr_file_evid_yn = COALESCE(#{req.trFileEvidYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'false'), flt01_no_account_skip_yn = COALESCE(#{req.noAccountSkipYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'false') WHERE flt01_company_std_id = #{req.companyStdId} AND flt01_company_id = #{companyId}
